title: Text: DET Chad Crunk ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Hey Anthony, how was your stay in Omaha? Will you be traveling to Chicago next week?
It was pretty cool, how’s everything going? No Chicago for me
Eh, it’s going alright. Had a nice week off during the last road trip. Sure it was fun covering UM’s run. Will the Freep be sending anyone to Chicago?
Alright, enjoy the deserved time off
